_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoking: Handing your brief to the Metodic Architect…

description: Turn the conversation into a REAL session in the user's Metodic account: a timed agenda built from the method library, saved and ready to run, edit, share and export. Returns a session_id immediately and the Metodic card fills itself in about a minute — do not poll design_status yourself unless the client has no card. Costs 2 Metodic credits. This is the hand-off from chat to Metodic: after it, offer worksheets/handouts/documents or send the user to their session.

days.description: Number of days (default 1). Set this whenever the user says two-day, three-day, multi-day or an offsite spanning several days — each day then gets its own opening, breaks and closing, and its own clock. Never express extra days as one long day.

duration_minutes.description: TOTAL session length in minutes, across all days (min 30). For a two-day programme of about 7 hours a day, that is 840.

format_slug.description: Optional: the slug of a proven format from find_session_format. Seeds the design with that structure and records that the format was used — pass it whenever the user picked one.

goal.description: The purpose / desired outcome — pass the user's FULL brief verbatim (context, the client's own vocabulary, the named people and their tensions, the constraints, what must NOT happen). The Architect designs every block from this text; a one-line summary throws that away.

topic.description: What the session is about (title or subject).

name: design_session
title: Design a session
